title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @_LuoFuli：MiMo-V2.6: The Hard Road to Scaling Up RL MiMo-V2.6 is very likely one of the largest single RL runs, by compute, that a
items.abstract_or_text: MiMo-V2.6: The Hard Road to Scaling Up RL MiMo-V2.6 is very likely one of the largest single RL runs, by compute, that any open-source model team has undertaken to date. In an era when compute is brutally scarce, we still chose to dedicate a team of several dozen people to one goal over an extended period: scaling up RL. The result is a model whose potential was built through mid-training and unlocked through heavy RL. Today, it is the number one open-source model. I strongly recommend reading the technical report. To help the open-source community focus on solving real Agentic RL problems, we have released a Qwen model distilled from MiMo RL trajectories as a stronger starting point for RL, along with 7K diverse environments and a complete RL training framework.
items.summary_zh: Fuli Luo 宣布 MiMo-V2.6，并称团队投入数十人长期扩展强化学习；帖文同时称已发布由 MiMo RL 轨迹蒸馏的 Qwen 模型、7,000 个环境及完整 RL 训练框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是对大规模 Agentic RL 训练资源与开放复现资产的具体披露；“第一开源模型”等排名表述属于作者观点，需以技术报告核验。
items.abstract_zh: MiMo-V2.6：扩展强化学习的艰难之路。按计算量计，MiMo-V2.6 很可能是任何开源模型团队迄今开展过的最大规模单次 RL 训练之一。在算力极度稀缺的时代，我们仍选择让数十人的团队在较长时间内专注于一个目标：扩展 RL。结果是，一个潜力通过中期训练构建、并由重度 RL 释放出来的模型。今天，它是第一的开源模型。我强烈建议阅读技术报告。为帮助开源社区聚焦解决真正的 Agentic RL 问题，我们发布了一个从 MiMo RL 轨迹蒸馏而来的 Qwen 模型，作为更强的 RL 起点，同时发布了 7,000 个多样化环境和完整的 RL 训练框架。

items.title: @OpenAI：We're demonstrating how frontier models have continued to improve in realistic mental health conversations with MentalHe
items.abstract_or_text: We're demonstrating how frontier models have continued to improve in realistic mental health conversations with MentalHealthBench. This new open benchmark was built with input from more than 80 mental health clinicians. We're releasing it openly so other researchers can examine the methods, run their own evaluations, and build on the work.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布开放 MentalHealthBench：该基准用于评估前沿模型在现实心理健康对话中的表现，构建时获得80余名心理健康临床医生的意见。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：开放基准及其临床输入为第三方复评提供了明确入口；帖文只说明其目的与发布，不足以单独证明模型在临床场景中的安全性或有效性。
items.abstract_zh: 我们正在展示，前沿模型如何持续改善在真实心理健康对话中的表现，所用的是 MentalHealthBench。这个新的开放基准由80多名心理健康临床医生参与构建。我们正将其开放发布，以便其他研究者检视方法、开展自己的评估，并在这项工作上继续推进。

items.title: @XiaomiTech_：A classic mathematical theorem. 6,000+ lines of Lean code. Verified by the kernel. Xiaomi MiMo 2.6 Pro assisted research
items.abstract_or_text: A classic mathematical theorem. 6,000+ lines of Lean code. Verified by the kernel. Xiaomi MiMo 2.6 Pro assisted researchers in fully formalizing the original main theorem of Li–Yorke's classic paper Period Three Implies Chaos in Lean 4. Guided by a research-designed exploration strategy, multiple Subagents collaborated on theorem formulation and proof formalization. After revision and integration, the project spans 6,000+ lines of Lean code, verified by Lean's kernel with no unfinished proof placeholders. Notably, Xiaomi MiMo 2.6 Pro was not specifically post-trained for Lean.
items.summary_zh: 小米称，MiMo 2.6 Pro 协助研究者在 Lean 4 中完整形式化 Li–Yorke 论文的主定理；项目逾6,000行 Lean 代码，并由内核验证且无未完成证明占位符。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：若代码与验证记录可获取，这是一项可检查的形式化数学案例；“模型未针对 Lean 专门后训练”是发布方陈述。
items.abstract_zh: 一个经典数学定理。6,000 多行 Lean 代码。由内核验证。小米 MiMo 2.6 Pro 协助研究者在 Lean 4 中完整形式化了 Li–Yorke 经典论文《周期三蕴含混沌》的原始主定理。在研究设计的探索策略指引下，多个子智能体协作完成定理表述和证明形式化。经修订和整合后，项目超过6,000行 Lean 代码，由 Lean 内核验证，没有未完成的证明占位符。值得注意的是，小米 MiMo 2.6 Pro 并未专门针对 Lean 做后训练。

items.title: @chelseabfinn：New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://pd-perry.githu
items.abstract_or_text: New blog post with @perryadong on what we need for robots to be broadly useful in the real world. https://pd-perry.github.io/posts/post-training.html Reliability is the one of the biggest open challenges in AI right now. Current models work out okay if a person will be reviewing the outputs (eg drafting code), but it will become more of a bottleneck as we want systems to act with more autonomy and more trust.
items.summary_zh: Chelsea Finn 与 Perry Dong 的博客讨论通用机器人走向现实部署所需条件；Finn 认为，可靠性是当前 AI 的主要开放挑战之一，人工复核仍会限制更高自主性系统的应用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该帖提出了从“有人审阅输出”的辅助式工作流转向自治系统时的可靠性瓶颈，是有具体问题定义的研究者观点，而非性能宣传。
items.abstract_zh: 我和 @perryadong 发表了一篇新博客，讨论要让机器人在现实世界中广泛有用，我们需要什么。https://pd-perry.github.io/posts/post-training.html 可靠性是当下 AI 最大的开放挑战之一。只要有人会审阅输出，当前模型的表现还算可以（例如起草代码）；但当我们希望系统以更高自主性和更高信任度行动时，它会变成更大的瓶颈。

items.title: @AnthropicAI：Claude has discovered a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages. Beside the enzyme's gene s
items.abstract_or_text: Claude has discovered a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages. Beside the enzyme's gene sits a long array of repeating DNA—a structure that looks somewhat similar to CRISPR. We don't yet understand what this system does, but only a handful of known systems share its features, and all of them are able to cut, copy, and paste DNA. Historically, the discovery of such programmable systems has helped revolutionize medicine. CRISPR, for instance, is now the foundation of genetic medicines. But it will take much more work to learn what this system does, and whether it can be put to similar use. Read more:
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 称 Claude 在噬菌体 DNA 中发现了此前未知的酶系统，酶基因旁有类似 CRISPR 的重复 DNA 阵列；该机构同时明确表示尚不理解系统功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是值得跟进的实验室研究发布，但其基因编辑用途和重要性尚未确定，不能将其表述为已证实的 CRISPR 替代方案。
items.abstract_zh: Claude 在噬菌体 DNA 中发现了一个此前未知的酶系统。该酶基因旁边是一长串重复 DNA 阵列——其结构看起来有些类似 CRISPR。我们尚不了解这个系统的作用，但只有少数已知系统具有其特征，而它们都能够切割、复制和粘贴 DNA。从历史上看，此类可编程系统的发现曾帮助推动医学革命。例如，CRISPR 现在已是基因药物的基础。但还需要更多工作来了解这个系统的作用，以及它是否能被用于类似用途。阅读更多：

items.title: @CRISPR_LuCas：As someone who did this kind of genome mining work during my PhD, some thoughts on this Anthropic announcement: Finding
items.abstract_or_text: As someone who did this kind of genome mining work during my PhD, some thoughts on this Anthropic announcement: Finding a weird cluster of genes and repeats is often the easy part. The hard part, and where the real discoveries come from, is figuring out what the system actually does. Anthropic does not yet know what this does. They've shown that the repeat array produces RNAs, but not what those RNAs do, what the RT does with them, or whether the system has any of the programmable properties that make the CRISPR comparison justified.
items.summary_zh: 曾从事基因组挖掘研究的 Lucas Harrington 评论 Anthropic 的公告：发现异常基因簇和重复序列往往较容易，真正的发现难点在于确定系统实际功能；他指出现有结果尚未说明重复 RNA、逆转录酶或可编程性质的功能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是一项具备相关研究经验的审慎解读，为上述发布补充了关键的验证边界，并推动对“类似 CRISPR”表述所需证据的专业讨论。
items.abstract_zh: 作为一名在博士期间做过这类基因组挖掘工作的人，我对 Anthropic 的这项公告有一些想法：找到一个奇怪的基因和重复序列簇通常是容易的部分。困难之处，也是产生真正发现的地方，是弄清这个系统实际做什么。Anthropic 目前还不知道它的作用。他们已经显示该重复阵列会产生 RNA，但尚未说明这些 RNA 做什么、逆转录酶对它们做什么，或该系统是否具有任何使与 CRISPR 的比较成立的可编程性质。

items.title: @fchollet：Delegate coding. Never delegate understanding. If code was previously your source of truth for managing understanding, t
items.abstract_or_text: Delegate coding. Never delegate understanding. If code was previously your source of truth for managing understanding, then you need a new source of truth artifact. If code-centric workflows were how you developed that understanding, then you need new workflows.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 提出，编码可以委托给 AI，但对系统的理解不能委托；若代码曾是理解的可信来源，团队需要新的可信工件和工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是针对 AI 辅助开发中知识维护与可追溯性的明确实践观点，虽非实证结果，但对工程团队的协作设计具有讨论价值。
items.abstract_zh: 把编码委托出去。永远不要把理解委托出去。如果代码先前是你管理理解的可信来源，那么你需要一个新的可信来源工件。如果以代码为中心的工作流曾是你形成这种理解的方式，那么你需要新的工作流。

items.title: @chelseabfinn：RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a
items.abstract_or_text: RL for dynamic tasks requires handling latency. Building on EXPO-FT, we let the base VLA operate on older images while a small edit policy operates in real time. Outperforms RTC by a significant margin, across the board. Paper: https://pd-perry.github.io/real-time-expo-ft/
items.summary_zh: Chelsea Finn 称，面向动态任务的 RL 必须处理延迟；其团队在 EXPO-FT 基础上让基础视觉—语言—动作模型处理较旧图像，并由小型编辑策略实时运行，帖文称其在各项测试中显著优于 RTC。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：该帖给出了机器人实时控制中“旧观测与快速校正”相结合的可检验技术路线；性能优越性的范围和实验细节仍应以所附论文为准。
items.abstract_zh: 针对动态任务的 RL 需要处理延迟。在 EXPO-FT 的基础上，我们让基础 VLA 在较旧图像上运行，同时让一个小型编辑策略实时运行。在各项测试中，它都以显著优势超过 RTC。论文：https://pd-perry.github.io/real-time-expo-ft/

items.title: How SWE-Serve Exposes the Gap Between Local Tests and Live Serving
items.abstract_or_text: An AI coding agent’s patch can pass tests yet fail when the server loads a real model and handles requests. Evaluating changes to inference-serving software...
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 技术博客指出，AI 编码智能体生成的补丁即使通过测试，也可能在服务器加载真实模型并处理请求时失败，聚焦本地测试与在线推理服务之间的评估缺口。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是来自官方技术博客的具体工程问题陈述，提醒评估编码智能体时需覆盖真实服务加载与请求处理，而非只看本地测试结果。
items.abstract_zh: AI 编码智能体的补丁可以通过测试，却可能在服务器加载真实模型并处理请求时失败。评估对推理服务软件的改动……
